_comment: Stations on the two Tokyo Metro extensions under construction. Both began
construction in November 2024 per Tokyo Metro's 2025-2027 Mid-term
Management Plan, each targeting a mid-2030s opening; the board outlives the
construction timeline, so they are on it (docs/decisions.md).
Lesson A3: future stations are not in OSM as ordinary station nodes, so
each position is recorded here with where it came from, rather than being

stations.name: Edagawa
stations.note: Provisional name (仮称). Between Toyosu and Toyocho on the Yurakucho line branch.
stations.source: OSM node 12765586687, construction:railway=station, name 枝川駅（仮称）, on the railway=construction ways tagged 有楽町線豊洲〜住吉延伸 (1019981869, 1378585824, 1378585825, 1378585828)

stations.name: Sengoku
stations.note: Provisional name (仮称). In Koto ward, between Toyocho and Sumiyoshi. Romanises identically to the Mita line's Sengoku (千石, Bunkyo ward), which already has an LED - the two labels will need disambiguating, and the provisional name may yet change.
stations.source: OSM node 12765586688, construction:railway=station, name 千石駅（仮称）, on the same railway=construction way

stations.name: Shinagawa
stations.note: Terminus of the Namboku line branch from Shirokane-Takanawa, 2.5 km with no intermediate station. The new platform will be under the station's west side; this is the existing JR/Keikyu station's position.
stations.source: OSM node 4011643454, railway=station, name 品川 (the Namboku branch itself has no OSM way yet)

insert.note: The branch leaves the main line at Toyosu (Y-22) and runs 4.8 km to Sumiyoshi. Toyocho (Tozai, T-14) and Sumiyoshi (Hanzomon Z-12 / Toei Shinjuku S-13) already have LEDs; this path adds them to the Yurakucho line and brings in two new stations.
The branch leaves the main line at Shirokane-Takanawa (N-03) and runs 2.5 km to Shinagawa with no intermediate station.
